note:
RECIST 1.1, the criteria themselves, in French -- the Eisenhauer revision that defines target and non-target lesions and the four response categories.

**What the corpus carries here is the definition, not the arithmetic.** Whether a 27% shrinkage is a partial response is a calculation, and calculations belong in `rcpia/rules/`, the same line the MNA cut-point sits on. What a passage can usefully say is what counts as a measurable lesion, how many target lesions to follow, and why a response must be confirmed -- the judgements a threshold cannot carry.

No rules: the document is three passages under two headings and carries no bibliography of its own.

default.note: Response evaluation applies to any measurable solid tumour under treatment, whatever the disease setting. Routing it to one would hide it from the others.
